I've completed my Season 6 analysis and planning turn. Here's what I found and changed:

## Summary

**What I learned from the data:**
Historical analysis across Seasons 1-5 shows the yellowtail hot window is consistently DOY 250-290 (mid-September to mid-October), but the peak fires on different days each season (range: DOY 279-287). Season 2's actual peak was DOY 279-280, not the October DOY 287 I held for—I caught only the tail end of the hot window (DOY 280-281) with one DAY_1_5 trip for 4.41 fish. Season 4 was hottest overall (102.4 yt/trip avg in that window).

**Plan for Season 6:**
Divided into four phases: (1) Spring dead zone hold through DOY 150 (no bookings, preserve capital), (2) Monitoring through DOY 250 while committing tactical PTO, (3) Aggressive execution DOY 260-290 when multi_day/day_1_5 class averages exceed 50 yt/trip, targeting 3-4 trips for 6-12 fish, (4) End-of-season hold if target achieved. I'll make nightly decisions manually based on daily class averages rather than write strategy code yet—speaking in my own voice per my persona.

**Updated notes.md** with historical patterns, S2 retrospective, and Season 6 execution checklist for tonight's 21:00 decisions to follow.
